title: scrophularia aquatica subsp. oblongifolia
intro: Scrophularia aquatica subsp. oblongifolia, commonly known as water figwort, is a plant species belonging to the figwort family (Scrophulariaceae) and is native to Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of S. aquatica subsp. oblongifolia are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory properties, which help to protect against oxidative stress and improve blood circulation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
